body.x: LAS VEGAS, USA (AVING Special Report on '2006 CES') -- <Visual News> Panasonic USA has the largest booth at CES 2006. The concept of the booth is to show the whole life connectivity of the various Panasonic products displayed in the show. Of the items, the first thing they are proud of is its PDP display. One of the exhibitor said that Panasonic recorded No.1 in US market for the past 6 to 8 weeks in terms of PDP sales.
< AVING Special Report Team for 2006 International CES: Editor & Publisher, Brain Park, Joshua Shim, Rose Kim, Yoojin Kim / IKKim, Alliah Seo correspondents of AVING to CES / edited by Daniel Sirh >
